Author: kaldigo
Name: Accord
Description: Configures the compatible Wrathful Combo engine through its settings API and manages static/live hotbars. Hotbar Bridge remains separate. Development preview.
Punchline: Reviewed intent settings and matching hotbars.
Changelog: Restore WrathCombo identity and migrate current WrathFork settings once with backups. Accord detects the compatible WrathCombo build. Remove legacy WrathFork before loading.

Author: kaldigo
Name: Aetherworks
Description: A modular collection of Final Fantasy XIV tweaks and quality-of-life tools. Every feature can be enabled or disabled independently.
Changelog: 0.1.5: Place FC deposit buttons above the gil balance, match their texture to the native History button, and move the saddlebag button inside its footer.

Author: kaldigo; based on MidoriKami's ExpandedHotbars
Name: ExpandedHotbars
Description: Create hotbars of any size, spacing, and keybinds, with functions to show and hide these bars dynamically.
Punchline: Add and control an unlimited number of custom additional hotbars.
Changelog: Adds per-hotbar Close After Use for mouse clicks and keybinds, plus a matching Kaldigo plugin icon. Auto-close follows activation attempts, including cooldown failures. In-game testing remains pending.

Author: kaldigo; based on Team Wrath's Wrath Combo
Name: Wrath Combo
Description: Wrath rotation engine fork with configurable continuation, targeting and support functionality. Configured independently or through its settings API. Accord-compatible build. Replaces stock Wrath Combo; remove the legacy WrathFork installation before loading.
Punchline: Configurable Wrath rotation engine and settings API.
Changelog: Restore WrathCombo identity and migrate current WrathFork settings once with backups. Accord detects the compatible WrathCombo build. Remove legacy WrathFork before loading.
